name: Scarlett Garcia
source: Scarlett is a mysterious prophetess who lives in Dale. I even introduced her to Ashley, who is now taking magic lessons from her. Scarlett is eccentric and extravagant. And once upon a time, a long time ago, she even had an affair with Arthur.
